key_insight: MV-PVMapper maps individual rooftop photovoltaic modules with near-complete recovery and precise boundaries, without task-specific annotations or model weight updates.
engineering_relevance: Accurate module-level maps can support rooftop PV inventory and inspection workflows using multi-view UAV imagery.
method: Generate module candidates with text-prompted SAM 3.
Project contours into object space with per-module slope correction and verify against representative module dimensions.
Feed accepted instances back to all covering views as box prompts for iterative segmentation and fusion.
evidence_signal: Across three operational rooftop plants surveyed from five directions at approximately 1 cm nadir resolution, two feedback iterations recovered 7,710 of 7,711 modules with no false positives at IoU ≥ 0.5 and achieved a site-averaged aggregated Jaccard index of 97.55%.
watch_item: Performance beyond the three evaluated rooftop sites remains unproven, and deployment depends on high-resolution multi-view imagery, photogrammetry and representative module dimensions.
paper_title: High-fidelity training-free photovoltaic module mapping from multi-view UAV imagery
